info.description: Legal / policy prose authored directly on the page — centred title plus a rich-text body (headings, lists, links).

showToc.description: Show the sticky table-of-contents sidebar (OneTrust style). Turn off for simple statement pages like Terms & Conditions.

titleColor.description: Override the title colour. Leave default for the legal navy.

bodyColor.description: Override the body (paragraph) colour. Leave default for near-black.
